user.title: EcoLife local server
user.description: Home Assistant will listen on this TCP port and act as the EcoLife report server. Devices are added afterwards with **Add device**.

data_description.port: Default 58300, the same as the EcoLife cloud.

error.port_in_use: This port is already in use on the Home Assistant host.

abort.already_configured: A server on this port is already configured.

new_device.title: Provision a new device
new_device.description:
These credentials were generated for the new device:

* Report server: `{host}:{port}`
* Token: `{token}`
* Key: `{key}`

1. Long-touch the top of the device until it enters pairing mode (Wi-Fi network `ecolife-add-device` appears).
2. Connect a computer to `ecolife-add-device`.
3. Run the `provision_device.py` tool from this integration's repository:

`{command}`

4. Submit this form. The device appears as soon as it reports to Home Assistant.

If `{host}` is not the address the device can reach Home Assistant at, use the correct one with `--host`.

existing_device.title: Add provisioned device
existing_device.description: Enter the token and key the device was provisioned with. The device must report to this server (its report host must be this Home Assistant).

error.invalid_token: The token must be 8 letters or digits.
error.invalid_key: The key must be 16 bytes encoded as base64.
